explanation_full: The SHAP analysis (Figure 3B) identifies the most influential features for the model. Based on the mean absolute SHAP values, VFA, Butyrate, and Acetate are the top three features. VFA has the highest mean absolute SHAP value (0.02848), followed by Butyrate (0.03228), and then Acetate (0.02847). Other features like ORP_Low, ORP_Mid, and COD-O also contribute to the prediction, with ORP_Low showing the highest value among the primary entities listed in the chart's result text (0.03747).
